content: Within six months, Sabrina will demonstrate the ability to build a tower of six to eight blocks independently in 4 out of 5 opportunities, enhancing fine motor coordination and motor planning during play.

Within six months, Sabrina will walk along a straight line for 3 meters without stepping off in 4 out of 5 trials, to improve gross motor control and balance necessary for safety in dynamic environments.

Within six months, Sabrina will demonstrate the ability to imitate horizontal, vertical, and circular strokes with a crayon on paper with minimal cues in 4 out of 5 attempts, enhancing foundation skills for drawing and writing.

Within six months, Sabrina will use both hands together functionally to push and roll a large ball to a partner in 4 out of 5 opportunities with minimal assistance, supporting development of bilateral coordination and cooperative play.

Within six months, Sabrina will demonstrate age-appropriate dressing skills by putting on and taking off a jacket with minimal assistance in 4 out of 5 opportunities, supporting increased independence in self-care routines.

Within six months, Sabrina will engage in sensory-rich play activities with appropriate sensory exploration and engagement in 4 out of 5 situations with minimal prompts, addressing sensory processing needs.

Within six months, Sabrina will use a spoon to scoop and bring food to her mouth independently with minimal spillage in 4 out of 5 opportunities, supporting the development of adaptive feeding skills.

Within six months, Sabrina will initiate and maintain interaction with peers during structured play activities for at least 5 minutes with no more than one prompt, enhancing social participation and play skills.
